skills_install.snapshot_note: Installation ran before this receipt and the last test-harness/documentation changes. Runtime/package source is unchanged; snapshot hash identifies that actual run.

limitations: No remote CI, Pages deployment or skills.sh external assessment observed.
Windows, Node24, PostgreSQL18 and Chromium local coverage; production TLS/authentication and full version/browser matrix untested.

Names/paths can contain sensitive information; recognized credential rejection and scans are not exhaustive.
Supported partial DSNs retain driver environment defaults.
Legacy deparsed-default and current stored-tree hashes are not semantically comparable.
Dynamic/routine/ORM/runtime consumer coverage remains partial or unknown; no apply API.
Creator comparison remains historical; no new paired executor/trigger/human evaluation.
npm publish manifest omits packageManager and pnpm-lock; frozen transitive installation uses the .skill archive.
